advancements.phonon.sound_check.title: Sound Check
phonon.add.processing: Adding %s... this can take a minute.
phonon.add.done: Added %s (%s, %s). Open a Speaker to play it.
phonon.add.error.name_taken: A track named '%s' already exists. Pick another name, or leave the name out.
phonon.add.error.tools_missing: Links other than direct .ogg files need yt-dlp and FFmpeg, and at least one is missing.
phonon.add.error.not_found: That link leads nowhere (404). Check the address, or whether the video was removed.
phonon.add.error.restricted: That link is private or needs a login. Try a public one.
phonon.add.error.bot_check: This site is blocking the server, so its links won't work either. Try another site.
phonon.add.error.region: That link is blocked in the server's region. Try another upload of it.
phonon.add.error.too_large: That audio is over this server's size limit. Raise maxAudioSizeMB in the server config, or pick something shorter.
phonon.add.error.unsupported: That site or page isn't supported. Try a direct video link, or a link to an .ogg file.
phonon.add.error.network: The server couldn't reach that site. Check its connection and try again.
phonon.add.error.timeout: That took too long and was stopped. Try again, or raise readTimeoutSeconds in the server config.
phonon.add.error.invalid_audio: That file isn't audio Phonon can read.
phonon.add.error.unknown: Couldn't add that audio. If it worked before, try /phonon tools update, then see logs/latest.log.
phonon.tools.offer: Phonon can install them for this game: %s
phonon.tools.install_disabled: Installing tools from in-game is turned off here. Install yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno on this computer, or set allowToolInstall in the server config.
phonon.tools.unsupported: Phonon has no tool builds for this computer. Install yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno by hand.
phonon.tools.installing: Downloading audio tools (%s). You can keep playing.
phonon.tools.update_system: yt-dlp isn't Phonon's own copy, and installing tools from in-game is turned off here. Update it the way you installed it.
phonon.list.empty: No tracks yet. Add one with /phonon add <link>, or put audio files in %s and run /phonon reload.
phonon.remove.from_folder: Its file is still in the music folder, and it returns on the next reload unless you delete the file.
phonon.config.header: Server settings. Change one with /phonon config <setting> <value>, or restore its default with reset:
phonon.import.started: Importing %s files from the music folder...

gui.phonon.speaker.select_hint: Select a track to see it here.
gui.phonon.speaker.empty_operator: No tracks yet. Type a song name above to find it, or put audio files in the world's phonon_music folder and run /phonon reload.
gui.phonon.speaker.empty_player: No tracks yet. Ask an operator to add some.
gui.phonon.speaker.queue_empty: Nothing in the queue. Double-click a track to play it, or press + on a track to play it next.
gui.phonon.speaker.playlists_empty: No playlists yet. Type a name above and press Enter.
phonon.permission.denied: You don't have permission to do that here.
phonon.add.error.refused: The site refused this for now. It often works on another try.
phonon.add.error.rate_limited: The site says this server has asked too much. Wait a while, then try again.
phonon.tools.stale: Phonon's download tool, yt-dlp, is %s days old, and sites change often.
phonon.tools.help.intro: Sites often distrust addresses from cloud hosts, and the server does all the downloading, so links fail too. In the server config:
phonon.tools.help.proxy: downloadProxy sends yt-dlp through another connection. It needs one the site doesn't block, which is often paid.
phonon.tools.help.cookies: cookiesFile uses a logged-in account. yt-dlp warns the account can be banned, so use a spare one, and keep the file private.
phonon.tools.help.token: For YouTube, yt-dlp's PO Token guide describes a plugin that may help, with no guarantee.
phonon.tools.help.update: First run /phonon tools update, since an old yt-dlp fails in similar ways.
gui.phonon.speaker.source_refuses: Sometimes refuses. Try again if it does.
